Thanks for a great renewal discussion last week. We want to proceed with the renewal and add a 30% capacity uplift effective at term start (oversubscription buffer). Our procurement team requires:

- A formal PO to reference on their side (they prefer Net45 terms)

Hi Sonia — thanks, happy to move forward. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Net45: we can approve Net45 for AtlasAI on this renewal; finance (cc'd) will confirm invoicing cadence.
- PO submission: please send the signed PO to billing@redwood.ai and include the Deal ID (DEAL-AT-2027-0091) in the PO header so our system can auto-match.
- Oversubscription billing: we propose a prorated charge on the first invoice that covers the uplift through the remainder of the term, with subsequent invoices reflecting the new committed capacity as a single line item. If you prefer a separate one-time addendum line, we can accommodate that — Marissa is drafting an addendum for your review.

Hi Sonia (and team),

Finance here. We can accept Net45 for AtlasAI, provided we have the following onboarded before the first invoice: 

1) Signed PO referencing Deal ID DEAL-AT-2027-0091
2) Completed W-9 (attached) or equivalent tax form for your entity
3) EFT authorization or bank onboarding (we use the Redwood EFT portal) — please complete the form at: https://redwood.ai/electronic-funds-transfer/onboard?ref=atlasai

Notes on invoicing cadence: 
- First invoice will include a prorated amount for the oversubscription (line item as "Oversubscription addendum - prorated").
- Subsequent invoices issued monthly in arrears on the 1st of each month.

Please send the PO to billing@redwood.ai. Once we receive PO + W-9 and the EFT onboarding confirmation, we will issue Net45 invoices per the agreed terms.
